issue.title: Glossary strand Node Panel still describes the deleted slim node spine

task_type_fields.proposed_change:
Proposed by phase bead sase-1bn.7 (PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP #1) and confirmed by the sase-1bn land agent after epic sase-1bn ("Agents node rail and unmistakable deck zoom") landed NodeSpine's deletion.

The strand still says `Ctrl+S` "collapses it into a slim node spine" and that "the spine and an info-row chip show the selected position and restore the panel". NodeSpine no longer exists (deleted in 2f03e5059). Replace that sentence with: `Ctrl+S` toggles a persisted, fixed-width (9-cell) row-for-row node rail that keeps every tribe panel and visible row as glyphs, so j/k, folds, hints, and the node finder still work and the identity header follows the selection; `Z` zoom hides the column entirely (flush-left deck), and any sidebar key while zoomed restores the pre-zoom layout. The info-row `nodes i/N · Ctrl+S` chip expands the rail. Keep the strand short; docs/ace.md "Agents Zoom and Node Rail" holds the full anatomy.

issue.creation_reason: Epic sase-1bn replaced the Ctrl+S node spine with a node rail and its plan forbade memory edits, so the stale glossary strand needs a user-authorized memory update.
